SELECT id , trainee_name , edu_start_date , edu_end_date , course_name , institution_name , course_status FROM edu_history
AND LOWER(course_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%')
AND LOWER(institution_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%')
AND ( LOWER(course_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(institution_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )
AND edu_start_date <= #{toDate} AND edu_end_date >= #{fromDate}
AND course_status = #{status}
ORDER BY id
